hero.headline: Study smarter,
hero.subheadline: Memoria is a modern learning platform that combines scientifically proven spaced repetition with AI-powered assistance — so you can study efficiently, understand deeply, and remember for longer.

mission.heading: Why we built Memoria
mission.p1: Most students waste hours re-reading the same material, only to forget it days later. Traditional flashcard apps help — but they don't explain. Search engines explain — but they distract.
mission.p2: Memoria was built to close that gap: a single place where you can memorize efficiently and get instant, trustworthy explanations without ever leaving your study session.

science.title: Science-backed
science.description: Every review is scheduled by the SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm — the same method used by millions of learners worldwide.

trust.title: Trustworthy by design
trust.description: The AI only answers from sources you upload. No hallucinations, no outdated training data — just your materials.

focus.title: Built for focus
focus.description: Everything lives in one place. No tab switching, no copy-pasting. Your study flow stays uninterrupted.

howItWorks.heading: How Memoria works
howItWorks.subheading: Three simple steps from zero to mastery.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.subheading: The algorithm tracks how well you know each card and schedules the next review at the optimal moment — just before you'd forget it.

step1.title: Study a card
step1.description: Flip the card, read the answer, and rate how well you remembered it — from Again to Perfect.

step2.title: Algorithm schedules the next review
step2.description: Based on your rating, the SM-2 algorithm calculates the ideal interval — hours, days, or weeks — before showing the card again.

step3.title: Long-term retention
step3.description: Over time, well-known cards are reviewed less often while difficult ones stay frequent — maximising retention with minimal effort.

ratings.heading: Rate what you know
ratings.subheading: After each card, you give honest feedback. The algorithm uses your rating to decide exactly when to show the card again.
ratings.again: Completely forgot — show again very soon
ratings.perfect: Instant recall — long interval, well learned

hero.subheadline: Most AI assistants answer from their training data — which can be outdated, wrong, or simply hallucinated. Memoria's AI answers only from the sources you provide.
hero.ragDescription: Searches your documents for relevant passages

problem.heading: The problem with generic AI
problem.subheading: General-purpose AI assistants are trained on the internet — which means they can confidently give you wrong answers.

generic.title: Generic AI
generic.con1: Answers from training data that may be outdated
generic.con2: Can hallucinate facts that sound plausible but are wrong
generic.con3: No connection to your course materials or professor's notes
generic.con4: No citations — you can't verify where the answer came from

memoria.title: Memoria AI
memoria.pro1: Answers only from documents you attach to the deck
memoria.pro2: Cannot fabricate information not present in your sources
memoria.pro3: Directly tied to your lecture notes, textbooks, and slides
memoria.pro4: Cites the exact source passage used in every answer

howItWorks.heading: How it stays grounded
howItWorks.subheading: When you ask a question, Memoria searches your attached documents for the most relevant passages using semantic search — then passes only those passages to the AI. The AI can only answer from what it's given.
howItWorks.step1: Your documents are split into chunks and stored as semantic vectors in a vector database.
howItWorks.step2: Your question is converted to a vector and the most similar chunks are retrieved.
howItWorks.step3: The AI receives only those chunks as context — it cannot access anything else.
